items.title: State Street Consumer Staples SPDR (XLP) Adds Walmart and Costco on Nov. 23
items.summary: The fund bought $266.6 million of stock and sold nothing, lifting all 33 of its positions.

items.title: Walmart’s shopper base is shifting: High earners lead its gains as low-income shoppers turn to Amazon
items.summary: Upper-income households led Walmart's market-share gains last quarter, while Numerator data shows lower-income shoppers shifting to Amazon and dollar stores.
